svg.title: Figure 129 — Exercise 23.1-1: Interconnection capacity
svg.desc: Left: a top view of a square hologram shared by four input beams, with one illuminated region highlighted. Right: the spatial-frequency plane for that region, not a physical screen. Frequencies must be separated by the reciprocal region width in each coordinate to give resolvable directions. Four inputs share the same total space-bandwidth capacity.
svg.text: Exercise 23.1-1: more input regions mean fewer resolvable directions per input.
One separate region per input beam.
Top view of the hologram, not a ray diagram.
Each dot is one resolvable spatial-frequency pair.
Frequency plane, not the output screen; schematic grid.
Multiply directions per input by the four inputs:
